gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-courier-: Expressive and low-slung, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps ascenders hugging the x-height, terminals flicking outward. Courier Prime keeps a drafting-pen line and generous round letters, so pages of monospace text stay tidy.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-days-one: Love Ya Like A Sister draws wirelike, outward-tipped letters with ascenders that barely clear the x-height. Days One fills the line with a tall x-height, and its rope-ladder spacing against those wire strokes is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-epunda-s: Wide counters and trimmed sidebearings give this body text real daylight inside every curve. Epunda Sans is the sans-serif that carries the reading, while Love Ya Like A Sister, monoline start to finish, handles the bold, expressive part.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-farro: Ascenders that barely clear the x-height give Love Ya Like A Sister its low, level stride. Farro, a sans-serif with no stroke contrast at all, keeps that bold personality grounded and approachable.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-fragment: Fragment Mono lines its monospace letters up like nails on a ruler, with no stroke contrast to slow the eye. Fragment Mono keeps the details orderly, leaving Love Ya Like A Sister to be the expressive, bold one.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-geist-mo: Ascenders barely clear the x-height in Love Ya Like A Sister. Next to it, Geist Mono's fixed-width, code-style monospace letters feel structured and technical, a sharp foil to all that bold expressiveness.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-genos: Low-slung and loud: Love Ya Like A Sister tucks its ascenders in, terminals pointing outward. Genos, plain sans with close-set glyphs and a high midline, does the quiet reading work that the heading skips.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-geom: Tubular, wire-like letterforms with ascenders that barely clear the x-height give Love Ya Like A Sister its odd, bold look. Geom adds a lofty lowercase band beneath it, standing tall and approachable.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-hammersm: Low and loud, Love Ya Like A Sister barely lifts its ascenders. Hammersmith One brings rounded, cord-like sans strokes and capitals barely taller than lowercase, and that shared lowness is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-inder: Inder is plain sans, with little height difference between its cases. Inder sits under the constant-width ribbon letters of Love Ya Like A Sister and lets the bold heading do the shouting.
